primary.title: EPFO pension: Karnataka HC rejects retirees' plea for higher payout. What does the EPS-95 ruling mean for you?
primary.summary: The Karnataka High Court has upheld amendments to EPS-95 pension rules, rejecting retirees' plea against lower pension payouts. The ruling clarifies changes to pension calculations, including early retirement reductions, and their impact on EPFO members.
